summary: SEMICON India 2026 (Applied Materials' $5bn Vision 2035 pledge, seven new Tata Electronics MoUs, Micron's assembly scale-up) dominated sentiment, directly rallying Kaynes, MosChip and Syrma SGS. Trump's Russia-sanctions law is a two-sided driver — a headwind for Russia-configured refiners and US-exposed textile exporters, but a tailwind for domestic E&P, Gulf oil-infra consultancy and the newly secured EU steel quota. Two clean map gaps surfaced: Ola Electric and Ather Energy were missing from the EV theme despite being direct PM E-DRIVE beneficiaries, and Waaree Renewable's new AI-data-centre subsidiaries were missing from the data-centre theme.
